newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse ends session 0.22 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse ends session 0.22 pct higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed its two-hour session on Tuesday 0.22 percent higher maintaining an active trading in the banking sector as well as in leading stocks, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index closed at 439.98 from 439.02 points on Monday.

"The whole market is going up though timidly, we can say that activity is steady after a too long period of stagnation, it will end the year on an optimistic note" a broker at Casablanca-based Maroc Inter Titres told Reuters.
Wafabank, a very liquid stock, fell five dirhams to close at 555 from 560 dirhams.

Wafabank has purchased Spanish Uniban bank last week but the final agreement would be sealed when Uniban's general assembly meets on December 30, and after approval by the monetary authorities officials said.
Uniban also shed two dirhams to 112 dirhams, brokers said.
Credit firm Credor CRD.CS, which was recently introduced on the stock market, jumped eight dirhams to close at 455 dirhams from 447 dirhams, on Monday.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, was up five dirhams to 505 dirhams.
ONA has diversified stakes in more than 100 companies and a capitalisation of more than 8.3 billion dirhams.
Total traded volume on the official market was 31 million against 30.1 million dirhams on Monday.
